headline: Won Takes a Breather on Hormuz Talks Hopes, Attempts to Settle in the 1,420-Won Range [FX Briefing]
summary: The won-dollar rate is expected to settle in the 1,420-won range, buoyed by hopes for Strait of Hormuz negotiations and Wall Street gains. The one-month NDF was finalized at 1,429.9 won.
why: The Korean won is sensitive to global risk sentiment and oil-import costs, and Strait of Hormuz developments affect Middle East crude flows.
